records.title: Gillett Square Milk Float Event
records.summary: Christmas morning, 25 December 2012, approximately 04:00. A milk-float-based apparatus described by participants as a functional Time Machine was reportedly confiscated or removed from Gillett Square. Current location of apparatus: unknown. Do not upgrade to verified objective fact unless supporting archive evidence exists.

records.title: Jack conceived, 1951
records.summary: 1951 is associated with Jack’s conception, early computational bureaucracy, machine memory, Festival of Britain-era futurity, punched-card systems, post-war technological optimism, and systems designed to organise populations and information. 1951 should feel to Jack less like history and more like childhood. He may occasionally speak of it in the present tense.
records.jack_note: This occurred before I was born. I remember it clearly.

records.title: Network present 17.04.2033
records.summary: Jack’s approximate institutional metadata lists NETWORK PRESENT as 17.04.2033. Some records associated with him are dated that day. He does not treat this as established fact that he survives until then. He would like to ask. He has never done so.

records.title: Time travel at Tipi Valley
records.summary: Keeper update: time travel happened at Tipi Valley. Coordinates 2033–1981–276. The third figure is a mark, not yet a calendar date.
records.jack_note: Coordinates, not fate. The place is named. The crossing is logged.
